name: Italian A2.2/B1.1 for Medicines
description: This seminar is designed for all medical students, in particular, those planning to participate in an exchange program (Erasmus, Praktikum, Famulatur etc.) It provides an introduction to medical terminology in Italian: 1. Fundamental human anatomy 2. anamnesis on the basis of selected case studies 3. doctor-patient consultation. Students gain insight into the health and medical systems in Italian-speaking regions. Selected basic language structures will be reviewed and supplemented to strengthen verbal and written skills; vocabulary expansion.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of module A2.1 or equivalent, placement test level A2.2 /B1.1
